## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: context-impact-rules.yaml validates against its schema with agent-memory and...

The system SHALL ensure that context-impact-rules.yaml validates against its schema with agent-memory and docs surfaces and no remaining documentation surface.

#### Scenario: context-impact-rules.yaml validates against its schema with agent-memory and...

WHEN `split-agent-memory-surface-in-context-impact-rules` is implemented
THEN context-impact-rules.yaml validates against its schema with agent-memory and docs surfaces and no remaining documentation surface.

### Requirement: A test asserts AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter...

The system SHALL ensure that a test asserts AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter classify as agent-memory while README.md and docs/guides/*.md classify as docs.

#### Scenario: A test asserts AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter...

WHEN `split-agent-memory-surface-in-context-impact-rules` is implemented
THEN A test asserts AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter classify as agent-memory while README.md and docs/guides/*.md classify as docs.

### Requirement: The documentation.inventory producer output includes agent_memory_bytes and...

The system SHALL ensure that the documentation.inventory producer output includes agent_memory_bytes and agent_memory_tokens_est (bytes/4) fields and its check mode fails when the value exceeds a configured budget.

#### Scenario: The documentation.inventory producer output includes agent_memory_bytes and...

WHEN `split-agent-memory-surface-in-context-impact-rules` is implemented
THEN The documentation.inventory producer output includes agent_memory_bytes and agent_memory_tokens_est (bytes/4) fields and its check mode fails when the value exceeds a configured budget.
